info.title: Traefik Console core-v2 API
info.description: Single-administrator console API. Every /api/v1 route except GET /api/v1/health and the public /api/v1/auth endpoints requires the tc_session cookie; state-changing requests also require the X-CSRF-Token header. Host/origin checks and write preconditions remain separate safeguards.

synthetic.summary: Synthetic shape example, not observed health

202.description: Saved, but Traefik could not be restarted. Body is the write result plus error ERR_MANUAL_RESTART_REQUIRED; restart Traefik manually.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Current resource version as a quoted integer, for example "3". Required to change or delete an existing resource unless If-None-Match: * is sent. Mutually exclusive with If-None-Match.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional 16-128 character key [A-Za-z0-9_-]. Repeating a completed write with the same key returns the recorded result instead of applying it twice.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: true validates and renders the change without publishing it and returns the preview (HTTP 200, no operation).

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: The "csrf" value of the current session.

delete.description: Reference-checked deletion with If-Match "<version>". Applied as one operation by rendering the configuration without the resource. With dry_run=true nothing is published and the preview is returned.

PluginUpdateInfo.description: Catalog comparison for one installed plugin. unknown means the catalog was never synced or a version could not be compared; it never means up to date. latest_version is the newest stable release (a prerelease only when the plugin already runs one); versions lists every cataloged release, newest first; can_update is true only for a managed plugin not pending removal.

Operation.description: One entry of the operations log. recovery_required blocks further writes until the operation is recovered or abandoned. restart_required means the change is saved and Traefik must be restarted manually.

domain_diff.description: Redacted Console-owned domain YAML diff, outside the Traefik watched directory.

validation_warnings.description: Nonblocking native warnings and advanced-rule TLS coverage uncertainty; never treat these as issuance/serving proof.

ConfigState.description: Drift, restart and recovery state of the three managed files. drifted means a file changed outside the console since the last publish; adopt accepts the on-disk files.

Snapshot.description: Restore point metadata. The sealed state and the exact managed file bytes are stored; no YAML or secrets are returned here. Pinned snapshots are never pruned; known_good marks a verified-working configuration.

Resolver.description: Exactly eight guided DNS providers. Custom YAML has bounded native ACME validation and external credentials; source-audited does not mean live verified.

entry_point.description: Compatibility probe target selector only; router entry_points owns routing. Not a domain routing entrypoint.

spec.description: Native HTTP fields use the committed Traefik v3.7.14 recursive inventory. Third-party plugin settings are opaque; [redacted] retains an existing leaf under the resource version.

lapi_key.description: Write-only credential input; reads return the retain marker ••••••••.

UIResource.description: Generic envelope; endpoints use concrete resource schemas.

is_secret.description: Known output-redaction defect: is_secret boolean metadata is masked by key name. Use type == secret for current guided forms; fixing metadata redaction is a separate backend task.

next_cursor.description: 0 when there is no further page; otherwise pass as cursor.

UploadCertificate.description: Paste PEM material, never filesystem paths. purpose defaults to server; server requires the matching private key; ca accepts CA certificate material. The response contains metadata, never key PEM. Total JSON body limit 4 MiB.

duration.description: Positive Go duration, at most seven days.

expiration.description: Optional positive Go duration, at most one year.

appsec_failure_block.description: Whether AppSec unexpected/failure responses block requests; defaults true and is tested separately from LAPI outage policy.

appsec_unreachable_block.description: Whether an unreachable AppSec endpoint blocks requests; defaults true.

lapi_key.description: Credential input; reads mask it as ••••••••. Retain an existing credential using the returned marker. Never store this input in browser persistence.

machine_password.description: Separate dashboard machine credential. Reads mask it; the retain marker preserves the encrypted stored value. It is used only by the Console backend and is never mounted into Traefik or returned as plaintext.

update_max_failure.description: Pinned bouncer failure policy: -1 never blocks solely because updates fail; 0 blocks on the first update failure; positive values bound consecutive failures.

CrowdSecConfigInput.description: Editable input. Omit computed response fields. Server validation also checks semantics and references.

entry_point.description: Compatibility probe target selector only; router entry_points owns routing. Not a domain routing entrypoint.

DomainInput.description: Domain preference: main and method; resolver method needs resolver, files method needs certificate. Resolver-backed routers request their own hostnames; domain SANs are optional explicit bundles, not a future-router allowlist. This alone does not create a router or prove issuance.

adopted.description: Send true to take over an entrypoint that is declared in traefik.yml (adoptable). Its original definition is kept and comes back when the entrypoint is deleted or an older snapshot is restored. Ignored for a console-created entrypoint.

kind.description: What the entrypoint is for. It must agree with the options: udp listens on UDP and the others on TCP; https requires http.tls and http forbids it; tcp (a plain TCP service) accepts no http, http2, http3, forwarded_headers or allow_acme_bypass. Omitted, it is derived from the settings. Never written to traefik.yml.

EntryPointInput.description: A listener of traefik.yml (Traefik v3.7). Only values that differ from Traefik defaults are written. protocol is fixed at creation. A udp entrypoint accepts only host, port, reuse_port and udp.timeout; a tcp one accepts everything except udp. http3 also takes the UDP port of the same number. Trusting every source (insecure) excludes a trusted_ips list. redirect.to is another tcp entrypoint or :port. Every write changes traefik.yml and restarts Traefik.

ResolverInput.description: acme: valid account email and challenge required; dns01 uses provider discovery, http01 needs a registered entry_point, tlsalpn01 needs public reachability on port 443. Environment defaults to production; choose staging explicitly for testing. custom: bounded custom_yaml, with external_credentials acknowledgment for DNS; no inline YAML secrets. Storage is server-owned.

entry_points.description: Registered TCP entrypoint names; UDP-only and unknown names are invalid for HTTP routers.

tls.description: Manual TLS mode only; ignored when domain_name supplies TLS. Resolver must exist, wildcard requests require DNS-01.

RouterInput.description: HTTP router input. Host/subdomain IDNA, paths and references are canonicalized. entry_points must be registered TCP listeners: omitted values use registered asDefault listeners, then an existing web/websecure name, then the sole TCP listener; ambiguous configurations require explicit selection. domain_name owns Host/TLS settings and overrides manual domains/tls; custom_rule still wins and TLS host coverage uncertainty is exposed in review warnings. Resolver-backed domain bindings automatically request the canonical router hostname without parent SAN edits. Explicit domain wildcard/SAN bundles are retained; a separate leaf request covers hosts outside that bundle. Imported certificates and manually supplied explicit TLS request names must still cover the bound host. Middleware order/repeats and provider identities are preserved.
